'''Virtual Block 8''' (Scoundrels) is a Players Committee '''legacy''' virtual expansion. These cards are no longer valid for competitive play; use the Decipher sets and the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward).

The official sheets are titled Virtual Block 8: Scoundrels,<ref name="vb81pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf ''Virtual Block 8: Scoundrels''] (PDF), res.starwarsccg.org. Cover: "Official text as of May 11, 2012". Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174544/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> Virtual Block 8: Agents For Hire,<ref name="vb82pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf ''Virtual Block 8: Agents For Hire''] (PDF), res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022233130/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_2.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> and Virtual Block 8: A Wretched Hive.<ref name="vb83pdf">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf ''Virtual Block 8: A Wretched Hive''] (PDF), res.starwarsccg.org. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174721/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_3.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The Players Committee issued the cards as printed slips: print the sheet, cut out the area beneath the card title, and sleeve the cutout with the original card.

The hub Date is that of the first subset, Virtual Set 8.1 Scoundrels ('''May 2012''').<ref name="vb81" /> Later subsets: 8.2 Agents For Hire (20 September 2012) and 8.3 A Wretched Hive (March 2013).

Scoundrels was announced on 14 April 2012.<ref name="ann81">[http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Scoundrels 8.1 Annoucement], starwarsccg.org (14 April 2012). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20120818111311/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=335&catid=1&Itemid=117 Internet Archive].</ref> Its announcement banner gave the release date as 11 May 2012.<ref name="vb81" />

The combined legacy list is also published as Virtual Master on the Players Committee cardlists.


Some of these cards were later reused in the current virtual sets (2014 Reset onward), usually with updated frames and set icons.

Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261020174544/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock8_1.pdf Internet Archive].</ref>

For remainder of game, Aurra, Galen, Mara, and your aliens with 'plotting to kill Jabba' in lore are assassins. Your cards with ability are deploy +3 except assassins and Independent starships. Characters add 1 to their Death Mark total for each weapon or device they carry. Once per turn, may deploy a Coruscant battleground from Reserve Deck; reshuffle. Flip this card if assassins control two battlegrounds (unless opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site) or a (Virtual Block 8) Death Mark attempt is made.

| 07 || [[File:VB8-07-Contract_Killers_Feared_Throughout_The_Galaxy.png|320px|link=Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]] || [[File:VB8-D-fearedthroughoutthegalaxy-pre.gif|200px|link=Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | [[Contract Killers / Feared Throughout The Galaxy|Contract Killers/Feared Throughout The Galaxy]] || style="white-space:nowrap" | [[Objective|Objective]] || While this side up, during your control phase, opponent loses 1 Force. If two assassins (except Galen) are in battle, add one battle destiny. Once per turn, if opponent just lost a character, an assassin there may gain 'reputation'; retrieve any one card (may only be canceled by Aim High) and stack it face down on that assassin. Assassins with 'reputation' may add 1 to Force drains where present. Flip this card at the end of any turn if opponent's non-droid character at a battleground site (unless (Virtual Block 8) Death Mark is on your side of the table.)

For remainder of game, your Trandoshans are slavers. Scum And Villainy may deploy on Slaving Camp Headquarters and may not be canceled while you occupy that site. While you have < 13 cards in hand, your non-unique slavers are immune to Grimtaash. Flip this card if your slavers control two Kashyyyk battlegrounds and opponent controls no Kashyyyk locations.

Once per turn, if you just retrieved Force during battle, may take a slaver, starship, or vehicle retrieved into hand. Flip this card if opponent controls two Kashyyyk battlegrounds.
